items.role: Chair of NYGH's Board of Governors
items.verbatim_snippet: Bert Clark was named the new Chair of NYGH's Board of Governors, succeeding outgoing Chair Samuel Elfassy, who completed his three-year term the same day. Bert Clark's tenure with the NYGH Board of Governors began in November 2016 when he served as a community member on the Board's newly formed Capital Development Advisory Committee.

items.role: President & CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: Karyn Popovich, NYGH's President & CEO, informed the Board of Governors that after a distinguished 40-plus year career as a health system leader, teacher, mentor, and accomplished nurse, she would be retiring, with the transition anticipated for mid-fall 2023. Popovich had served as president and CEO since October 2020, capping a 40-year career at NYGH.

items.role: President and CEO
items.verbatim_snippet: North York General Hospital announced Dr. Everton Gooden as its next President and CEO following a search process. Dr. Gooden joined NYGH more than 20 years earlier and combined clinical, administrative, and leadership experience, having served as Chair of the Medical Advisory Committee, President of the Medical Staff Association, Division Chief of Head and Neck Surgery, and as a member of the NYGH Foundation Board.

Serda Evren is a senior communications leader with experience shaping trust, reputation, and organizational clarity in complex environments, having spent over 14 years at Mastercard, most recently as Vice President, Global Brand Strategy.
